title: 第8章 疗伤练气四层第9章 炼丹房当差
content_zh:
“今日，杂役姜班头没来，此人怀疑，是姜班头监守自盗，带着茱萸果逃出了宗门。”
“陆寒，你怎么看？”
陆寒？
徐长生心中默念这个名字，面上依旧恭顺。
陆寒扫了徐长生一眼，上前一步，神色淡然，“莫长老，若这位杂役弟子所言属实，那姜班头的确嫌疑重大。”
“不如，我们这就去他的住所搜一搜。”
莫长老点了点头，“也好。”
众人立刻前往姜老大的住处。
此地和徐长生住的小院一样，但徐长生他们是八人间，而姜老大是单人单院。
“轰”
门被暴力踹开。
姜老大自然不在屋内。
莫长老目光如电，扫视屋内，灵识更是呼啸而出，仔细探索每一寸地面。
突然，那两名手持铜镜的外门弟子，发出了一声惊呼。
他们手中的铜镜，竟亮起了淡淡青光！
明明没有灵植，却依然有灵气波动。
可见，此地先前有灵气充沛的灵植出现过，所以才会在灵植消失后，仍然残留着灵气！
即便不是茱萸果，也是价值非凡的灵植。
姜老大此时又失踪了。
不得不让人联想到，监守自盗！

莫长老此时已经脸色一片铁青。
“传我令，派人下山追捕姜班头。活要见人，死要见尸！”
“是！”
几名外门弟子领命而去。
莫问长老的目光，再次落在徐长生身上。
“你叫什么？”
“弟子徐长生。”
“你揭发有功，这瓶中品聚气丹，赏你了。”
徐长生心中一喜，连忙双手接过丹药，躬身道谢，“多谢长老！”
一瓶中品聚气丹，经过小青葫强化之后，那就是二十颗极品聚气丹。
再加上从姜老大那里搜刮的战利品，说不定他能一举突破到练气后期！
莫长老御空而起，化作一道青虹，消失在灵植园上空。
一场危机，似乎就此化解。
徐长生松了口气，正要随着人群散去。
忽然。
一只手，轻轻搭在了他的肩上。
徐长生浑身一僵，缓缓转过身。
content_en:
"Today, the handyman Jiang Bantou did not come. This person suspects that Jiang Bantou was the keeper and escaped from the sect with the dogwood fruit."
"Lu Han, what do you think?"
Lu Han?
Xu Changsheng recited this name silently in his heart, his face still respectful.
Lu Han glanced at Xu Changsheng, took a step forward, and said with a calm expression, "Elder Mo, if what this handyman disciple said is true, then Team Leader Jiang is indeed a serious suspect."
"Why don't we go to his residence and search it."
Elder Mo nodded, "That's fine."
Everyone immediately went to Boss Jiang's residence.
This place is the same as the small courtyard where Xu Changsheng lives, but Xu Changsheng and the others live in an eight-person room, while Boss Jiang lives in a single room.
"Boom"
The door was violently kicked open.
Mr. Jiang is naturally not in the house.
Elder Mo's eyes were like lightning, and he scanned the room. His spiritual consciousness roared out, and he carefully explored every inch of the ground.
Suddenly, the two outer disciples holding bronze mirrors let out a cry of surprise.
The bronze mirrors in their hands actually lit up with a faint green light!
There is obviously no spiritual plant, but there is still spiritual energy fluctuation.
It can be seen that a spiritual plant with abundant spiritual energy appeared here before, so after the spiritual plant disappeared, the spiritual energy still remained!
Even if it is not a dogwood fruit, it is still a spiritual plant of extraordinary value.
Boss Jiang disappeared again at this time.
It can't help but remind people of being a thief!
Elder Mo's face was livid at this time.
"Pass my order and send people down the mountain to hunt down Bantou Jiang. If you want to see him alive, you want to see his corpse!"
"Yes!"
Several outer disciples took the order and left.
Elder Mo Wen's eyes fell on Xu Changsheng again.
"What's your name?"
"Disciple Xu Changsheng."
"You have done a good job in exposing this. I will reward you with this top-quality Qi Gathering Pill in a bottle."
Xu Changsheng was overjoyed and quickly took the elixir with both hands, bowed and thanked, "Thank you, elder!"
A bottle of mid-grade Qi Gathering Pills, after being strengthened by Xiao Qinghu, becomes twenty top-grade Qi Gathering Pills.
Coupled with the trophies collected from Boss Jiang, maybe he can break through to the late stage of Qi training in one fell swoop!
Elder Mo rose into the air, turned into a blue rainbow, and disappeared over the Spiritual Plant Garden.
A crisis seemed to be resolved.
Xu Changsheng breathed a sigh of relief and was about to disperse with the crowd.
suddenly.
A hand gently rested on his shoulder.
Xu Changsheng froze and turned around slowly.
